entries.title: Show HN: Why write code if the LLM can just do the thing? (web app experiment)
entries.author: samrolken
entries.current_title: Show HN: Why write code if the LLM can just do the thing? (web app experiment)
entries.excerpt: I spent a few hours last weekend testing whether AI can replace code by executing directly. Built a contact manager where every HTTP request goes to an LLM with three tools: database (SQLite), webResponse (HTML/JSON/JS), and updateMemory (feedback). No routes, no controllers, no business logic. The AI designs schemas on first request, generates UIs from paths alone, and evolves based on natural language feedback. It works—forms submit, data persists, APIs return JSON—but it's
entries.guide_zh: 把联系人管理请求直接交给语言模型执行，作者试验 AI 能否代替应用代码。
